help.notes.zh-CN:
• 吸附阈值约为 12 个逻辑像素，在菜单中可统一关闭屏幕及盒子边缘吸附。
• 鼠标触到屏幕顶部后松开可最大化，左右边缘可切换半屏；与窗口边缘吸附独立。
• 进入子目录不会修改设置的根目录；重新打开盒子从设置目录开始。
• 菜单中可打开 Linux 回收站、选择 Linux 打开方式、调整背景透明度。
• 每个盒子分别保存文件夹、视图、排序、位置、透明度和收起状态；语言设置对全部盒子生效。
• 开机自启为全局选项，可从托盘或盒子菜单设置。
• 开启“悬停时临时展开”后，移入收起的盒子展开，移出自动收起。
help.notes.en-US:
• Magnetism uses a threshold of about 12 logical pixels. Its menu switch controls screen-edge and box-edge snapping together.
• Release the pointer at the top screen edge to maximize, or at a side edge for half-screen layout. This is independent of edge magnetism.
• Browsing subfolders does not change the configured root. Reopening starts at that root.
• Use the menu for Linux Trash, Linux Open With, and background transparency.
• Each box saves its own folder, view, sorting, position, opacity and collapsed state. Language is global.
• Start at login is a global option in the tray or box menu.
• Enable Temporarily expand on hover to reveal a collapsed box while the pointer is inside it.
